criteria: retained legacy manifest status is exactly empty
subject.json identity matches manifest legacy_subject identity

semantic_rules.technical_image_verification: NOT APPLICABLE — zero retained image references

rationale: A retained source with a fully verified empty payload is processed as a source occurrence, but absence of retained content is not evidence of a Book, Unit, Lesson, or page boundary. This separates source-processing completeness from semantic-structure verification and prevents fabricated educational entities.
